title: Stalk tensor multiplication range
statement: Under the hypotheses and notation of the ideal multiplication stalk range theorem, before replacing the multiplication map by its image inclusion, the range of the stalk multiplication map is the ideal generated by the stalk image of ι times the top submodule of the stalk of F.

proof.text: Use the stalk tensor comparison and its germ formula to identify the stalk of the sheaf tensor multiplication with multiplication of stalk germs. Under the germ compatibility hypothesis for e, a pure tensor maps to e of the stalk image of ι applied to the first factor, times the second factor.

Pure tensors generate the tensor product, so the image is contained in the ideal generated by the stalk image times the top submodule. Conversely every generator is the image of a pure tensor, giving equality.

lean.statement: theorem stalk_tensor_multiplication_range {X : Scheme.{u}} {J : X.Modules} (ι : J ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (F : X.Modules) (x : X) (e : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≅ ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (he : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) (r : Γ(X, U)), e.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf U x hx r) = X.presheaf.germ U x hx r) : letI : MonoidalCategory X.Modules := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf let S := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x LinearMap.range (S.map (ι ▷ F ≫ (λ_ F).hom)).hom = (LinearMap.range (S.map ι ≫ e.hom).hom : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) • (⊤ : Submodule (X.presheaf.stalk x) (S.obj F))
